# DeferredFieldProcessor

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Migration.Import.DeferredFieldProcessor`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Migration`

## Summary

Processes deferred fields after the initial entity import. Deferred fields are self-referential lookups that couldn&#x27;t be set during initial import because the target records didn&#x27;t exist yet.
